content: In order to further reduce the dimensionality of the spatio-temporal encodings and cancel background noise effects BIBREF21 , we train an unsupervised deep autoenoder (DAE) on the fused heterogeneous features produced by the combined CNN and LSTM information. The DAE forms our second level of hierarchy, with 3 encoding and 3 decoding layers, and mean squared error (MSE) as the cost function.
